tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent, success, warning, danger.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: sheets, cards, inputs, mini-player. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken areas and chips: waveform track, segmented controls, disabled fields. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300 and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (dates, capture details, helper text) on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300 and accent-soft. Never for the only copy of an instruction.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline between rows. Carries no meaning; for a control border use line-strong.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons and unselected controls, and waveform rest bars; 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The ONE accent, reserved for sound: pins, play, record, waveform progress, links. Text/icon colour on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300, accent-soft and the map. Never a decorative colour.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a solid accent fill (primary button, record button).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected rows, the playing recording and the active pin halo. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2 px focus outline plus 2 px offset; 3:1 on every surface, accent-soft and accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Published / saved states, always with the word and a check icon. Teal, told apart from danger by word and icon, never by hue alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Processing, low quality or approximate location, always with the word and an icon. Text on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, removal, blocked permissions, always with the word and an icon. Text on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Quiet basemap land. The map shows nothing louder than this except pins.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Quiet basemap water.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Quiet basemap roads and boundaries. Decorative.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: Place names drawn on the basemap, on map-land; 4.5:1.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on desktop and the name of a place on the full recording page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Place name in the place sheet, section titles on desktop.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Recording title, dialog titles, empty-state headlines.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Descriptions, 'what you can hear' text, form copy. Never smaller on mobile.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy and list titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, attribution, helper and error text. Minimum size in the product.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Technical facts: sample rate, bit depth, duration, LUFS, file size, hash.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of dense rows, gap between related fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding of cards and sheets, page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a sheet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop, gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large vertical rhythm on desktop pages.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty states and hero spacing.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of every interactive control.

tokens.name: target-record
tokens.usage: Diameter of the record button.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs' inner elements, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Place sheet top corners, dialogs, mini-player.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pins, record button, toggles, chips.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Place sheet and mini-player lifting over the map.

tokens.name: shadow-pin
tokens.usage: Pins and clusters over the map.
